notes: Salesforce Commerce Cloud site (store-locator URL exposes on/demandware.store/Sites-fv-Site). Direct fetch worked throughout, no blocking encountered. Full nav mega-menu pulled from homepage plus each Accessories branch page crawled directly. Furniture-led DTC retailer per brief note: checked thoroughly, only one decor-relevant top-level branch exists (Accessories), containing Lighting, Wall Art, Mirrors, and Home Furnishing; no separate room-based lighting or mirror trees exist on this site (e.g. no bathroom/vanity mirror nodes, no lighting-by-room nodes) so Rule 0 did not surface any extra rows here -- the site's own taxonomy is a flat type tree, nothing was skipped for a room-word reason. Counts verified via the rendered 'View N items' header on each category/sub-category page, confirmed stable across two independent reads (Mirrors=145 twice, Wall Mirrors=99 twice). Children-sum-to-parent check: Lighting children sum to exactly 450 = parent header (450) -- exact match. Wall Art children sum to 172 vs parent header 171 (1-item session drift, each leaf's own header trusted per Rule 1). Mirrors children sum to 147 vs parent header 145 (2-item drift, same treatment). Excluded: Rugs (textile, all types), Cushions (textile), Artificial Plants (faux plants/flowers exclusion). Home Furnishing (569 total) is a mixed roll-up containing Cushions and Artificial Plants alongside decor items, so it is emitted only as a parent grouping row (no qty) with only its genuinely decorative children (Clocks, Vases, Finishing touches & ornaments) extracted as leaves, per the mixed-roll-up rule. Verified Finishing touches & ornaments (27 items) by reading actual product titles -- all genuine decor (sculptures, bowls, trays, wine coolers, an LED-candle lantern), zero scented candles / home fragrance products, so the node was kept whole. Dropped as facet/shape re-cuts (confirmed via canonical URL self-check): mirrors/arch, mirrors/decorative, mirrors/rectangle, mirrors/round (shape facets of the parent Mirrors category, own self-canonical but shape re-cuts of the type tree); mirrors/mirrors and mirrors/leaner-mirror (singular) canonicalize back to /accessories/mirrors/, pure duplicate aliases; home-furnishing/bowls, /tray, /bottle-holders, /ornaments all canonicalize back to /accessories/home-furnishing/ (facet re-cuts, generic shared page title, not real subcategories). Colour facets (black/grey/gold/etc.) present under every branch, all confirmed as filter re-cuts, excluded throughout.
